items.headline: Charbonnet will not be activated for Thursday vs. Broncos
items.summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Charbonnet (knee) stays on reserve for Thursday night's game against Denver, so George Holani remains in the lead role.

items.headline: Palmer out for Monday night
items.summary: Palmer (shoulder) is ruled out against the Rams. Skyler Bell is expected to make his NFL regular-season debut.

items.headline: Eagles back Shipley hurt in London
items.summary: Shipley (foot) left the loss to Jacksonville. Philadelphia was already without Saquon Barkley, so the backfield looks depleted heading into next week.

items.headline: Montgomery ruled out of Texans win with groin injury
items.summary: Montgomery left the win over Tennessee with a groin injury. Next week's status is unknown, so Houston's backfield share is uncertain.

items.headline: Henderson leaves Patriots win with ankle injury
items.summary: Henderson was ruled out for the rest of the Raiders game. Rhamondre Stevenson is the other main back, so New England's workload could shift next week.

items.headline: Concepcion exits Browns loss with head injury
items.summary: Concepcion left the game at the Jets after a hit to the head and was ruled out. A concussion would put next week in doubt.

items.headline: Hockenson suffers a concussion vs. Saints
items.summary: Hockenson left Minnesota's win with a concussion, which puts his availability next week in question. Ben Yurosek was active today.

items.headline: Roman Wilson expected to miss multiple weeks
items.summary: A source told ESPN Wilson (finger) will miss multiple weeks, joining a growing list of injured Steelers receivers. Pittsburgh's wide receiver room is thin.

items.headline: Penix left overtime loss with rib injury
items.summary: Penix (ribs) did not return in overtime, and Tua Tagovailoa played in relief. ESPN says Penix does not believe it is serious, so next week's starter is unclear.

items.headline: 49ers lose Samuel to hamstring injury
items.summary: Samuel left the win over Seattle in the third quarter, leaving San Francisco with just three healthy receivers. His availability next week is unknown.

items.headline: Jackson inactive again, real chance to return vs. Browns
items.summary: Jackson (ankle) missed Sunday night, a win for Tyler Huntley in overtime. ESPN reports he has a real chance to play next week at Cleveland, pending how he responds.

items.headline: Harrison joins Texans after trade
items.summary: Houston acquired Harrison from Arizona. ESPN's fantasy desk calls C.J. Stroud the clear winner and Michael Wilson and Trey McBride the top options in Arizona. His role in Houston is not yet defined.

items.headline: Moore questionable for Monday night
items.summary: Moore (shoulder) is questionable after practicing in a noncontact jersey, and Joshua Palmer is out, so Buffalo's receiver group is thin against the Rams.

items.headline: Barkley missed London game with hamstring injury
items.summary: Barkley was inactive against Jacksonville. His availability for next week is unknown, and Dameon Pierce led the backfield with 11 carries for 14 yards.

items.headline: Sadiq enters concussion protocol after Jets win
items.summary: Sadiq did not return to the win over Cleveland because of a concussion, which makes next week uncertain.

items.headline: Dowdle inactive, Warren dominates
items.summary: Dowdle (toe) was inactive and Jaylen Warren had his third straight game of at least 125 all-purpose yards. Warren stays the lead back while Dowdle is out.

items.headline: Williams close to returning, no date set
items.summary: Ben Johnson did not commit to a return date for Williams (hamstring) after the loss in Green Bay, and said it could be Atlanta or later. Tyson Bagent remains the starter until then.

items.headline: Judkins seen in a walking boot after Jets loss
items.summary: Judkins was wearing a boot on his right foot after Sunday's loss. Raheim Sanders is the main alternative if he misses time.

items.headline: Huntley leads Ravens to overtime win
items.summary: Huntley led a late tying drive and scored in overtime against Atlanta. He stays the starter until Jackson is cleared.

items.headline: Moore leaves Packers win with ankle injury
items.summary: Moore left the 31-7 win over Chicago. Christian Watson had 143 yards and two touchdowns, so his role looks secure.

items.headline: Kennedy leaves Lions win on crutches
items.summary: Kennedy (knee) left the win over Arizona on crutches. He is a depth receiver.

items.headline: Harris hurt his hamstring vs. Broncos
items.summary: Harris (hamstring) was questionable to return in the loss to Denver. The winless Chargers lack receivers with Quentin Johnston out.
